translator_notes: This page lists recommended companion books
The first book 'Dream, Create, Transform!' by Sarah Lacy is about Silicon Valley entrepreneurs
The second book 'Nerds Can Do Business Too' by Maxim Kotin is particularly relevant as it parallels the theme of technical people becoming successful entrepreneurs
The word 'ботаники' (botanists/nerds) is a key theme throughout the Durov book
